question: An engineer configures a role for a new user in Cisco UCS Manager. The role should allow the user to configure vHBAs, vNICs, and server port types. Which role should be assigned to allow the engineer to complete this task?
theory: The Network Administrator role in Cisco UCS Manager grants read/write access to fabric interconnect infrastructure and network security operations, which includes configuring vHBAs, vNICs, and server port types - all objects tied to the fabric-facing network configuration. This differs from the Server Compute role, which explicitly excludes creating, modifying, or deleting vNICs/vHBAs even though it otherwise has broad service-profile access. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 19 - Securing UCS Management, Default User Roles)
